'''Chico''' (also '''Valley Maidu''') is an extinct [[Maiduan]] language formerly spoken by [[Maidu]] peoples who lived in Northern California, between Sacramento and the Sierra foothills. It may be a divergent dialect of [[Konkow language|Konkow]] or an independent language.<ref>{{Cite book |last=Golla |first=Victor |url=https://www.worldcat.org/title/668191602 |title=California Indian languages |date=2011 |publisher=University of California Press |isbn=978-0-520-26667-4 |location=Berkeley |oclc=668191602}}</ref>
